title: Freya and the Horizon
author: Oscar Brightwater
blurb: Rosalind Whitlock, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
